title: Reader daemon: RFC 3977 NNTP protocol surface and article number synthesis
description: Implement the usenet-ipfs-reader binary's NNTP protocol surface. All RFC 3977 mandatory and optional commands must work with unmodified slrn, tin, pan, gnus, and Thunderbird. Article numbers are synthesized locally per (group, server) and stored in SQLite. Overview index supports OVER/XOVER. STARTTLS and AUTHINFO supported.
